title: Listen Listen Listen
about: It is printed in Rainbow AU songs, vol. A, song #224, printed page A(43), PDF p.48 (hand-notated with chords). An independent version for comparison lives in SRF Cosmic Chants p.9 (© Self-Realization Fellowship).
